title: Auto Detect Mask v2 — SAM3 text-prompt + click-to-point masking
description:
Today img_auto_mask.json is capped by its DETECTOR VOCABULARY, not by its segmenter. It runs UltralyticsDetectorProvider with only four models installed (bbox/face_yolov8n.pt, bbox/hair_yolov8n-seg_60.pt, bbox/hand_yolov8n.pt, bbox/person_yolov8n-seg.pt) -> ImpactSimpleDetectorSEGS -> SAMLoader (sam_vit_b) refine -> ImpactSEGSPicker. YOLO only finds classes it was trained on, so "mask the headphones" is impossible and always will be on that path.

SAM3 replaces the detector with an OPEN VOCABULARY. The nodes are already CORE (comfy_extras.nodes_sam3, no custom pack). SAM3_Detect inputs: model (MODEL, from a checkpoint loader), image, threshold (= the confidence slider), refine_iterations (SAM decoder passes, 0 = raw detector masks), individual_masks (per-object vs union), plus OPTIONAL conditioning (CONDITIONING from CLIPTextEncode = the TEXT prompt), bboxes (BOUNDING_BOX), positive_coords / negative_coords (STRING, JSON [{"x":int,"y":int}] in PIXEL coords = click-to-mask). Outputs masks + bboxes.

WEIGHT: Comfy-Org/sam3.1 -> checkpoints/sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors, 1,745,546,848 bytes (1.75GB), lands in models/checkpoints/ and loads through a checkpoint loader (that is why the widget is a ckpt list). USE THE REPACK - facebook/sam3 is gated:manual, Comfy-Org/sam3.1 is NOT gated, so this needs no MPI-357 licence gate.

LICENCE IS SHIPPABLE: SAM License dated 2025-11-19 grants use, reproduce, DISTRIBUTE, copy, derive and modify, royalty-free, with NO non-commercial clause (unlike FLUX NCL). Conditions: a copy of the Agreement must travel with the weights when redistributed, research use must acknowledge, no reverse engineering, plus trade-control / no-weapons / privacy terms. So we may host it on R2 provided the licence text ships beside it.

ALREADY AVAILABLE WITH ZERO DOWNLOADS: Impact Pack Preview Bridge (Image) right-click -> Open in SAM Detector gives point-click masking with a threshold against the sam_vit_b weight the auto-mask graph already loads. That is the ComfyUI-side editor the user remembered. It is a bench convenience, NOT a product surface - our users never see the ComfyUI canvas.

IN-GRAPH interactive equivalent: PointsEditor (kjnodes) has a click UI over a bg_image and outputs positive_coords / negative_coords strings that drop straight into SAM3_Detect.

attention.reason: Phase A is USER-VERIFIED end to end, including the detection colour. Remaining on this card: docs home for click-point masking, and Phase B (SAM3 text prompts).

scope_decisions.path: PHASE A FIRST, PHASE B AFTER. A = click-points + confidence on the sam_vit_b weight the auto-mask graph ALREADY loads (Impact Mask Pointer: MaskToSEGS combined=False -> SAMDetectorCombined detection_hint=mask-points). Zero download, zero licence, zero dep entry. B = swap SAM3_Detect in behind the same UI for open-vocab text, true negative points and box prompts (1.75GB). B ships as its own card once A is user-verified.
scope_decisions.yolo: KEPT. The 4 Ultralytics models stay as a fast one-click Face / Hair / Hand / Person shortcut. Points sit BESIDE them, they do not replace them.
scope_decisions.shapes: Split out to MPI-368 - rectangle / triangle / ellipse gizmo, Add or Subtract into the mask.
scope_decisions.tools: 2026-07-28 (user): the mask surface becomes a TOOL FAMILY, not one panel with a source radio - Points (Phase A, shipped), Detect (YOLO, shipped), Shapes (MPI-368), Text (Phase B of this card). Every tool carries the SAME bottom strip (brush, eraser, invert, clear, opacity), which must be extracted into ONE shared component instead of copy-pasted per tool. The split + extraction is MPI-371; the tools themselves stay on their own cards.

acceptance: PHASE A: mask tool gains a 'points' mode - left-click places a positive point, right-click a negative one, points render on the overlay and can be individually removed
PHASE A: a confidence slider is bound to SAMDetectorCombined.threshold (default 0.93). Verify the documented behaviour live - raising it narrows the selection (clothes instead of whole person)

PHASE A: graph branch MaskToSEGS(combined=False, drop_size small) -> SAMDetectorCombined(detection_hint='mask-points') returns a mask for a click on an object the YOLO detectors cannot find - verify on the headphones case that started this
PHASE A: negative-point mechanism decided and proven - either mask_hint_use_negative='Small' (smaller dot = negative, polarity by brush size) or two separate point layers. Do not ship the ambiguity
PHASE A: existing Detect button drives the points run; thumbs / pick / composite plumbing reused, not forked (commandExecutor.js autoMaskImg path + MpiAutoMaskThumbs)
PHASE A: YOLO detector dropdown still works unchanged - regression-check Face and Person after the graph edit
PHASE A: multi-pick contract preserved - the workflow still emits 1 mask per pick via ImpactSEGSToMaskList, never SegsToCombinedMask (shipped 1.2.0 trap)

PHASE B (own card): sam3.1_multiplex_fp16 dep entry, sha256 9ba99c92703c2e8b4f47de2d34a539bb8e18923049e238b780d70dbe6368eb03, 1745546848 bytes, checkpoints/ folder type, SAM License text shipping beside the weight. Comfy-Org/sam3.1 is NOT gated so no MPI-357 licence gate

PHASE B: SAM3_Detect TEXT path via CLIPTextEncode conditioning. NOTE its threshold gates TEXT detections ONLY - it is not the point-path confidence dial, so the slider stays wired to the Impact path or the UI must explain the split

PHASE B: positive_coords / negative_coords are forceInput:true (a FRONTEND hint - the API accepts a literal). Feed them from MpiString nodes titled Input_Points_Pos / Input_Points_Neg rather than betting on widget injection
PHASE B: autoMaskImg op reconciled - currently promptRequired:false and universal. A text prompt changes that contract, so decide prompt box vs a small field in the mask tool
If any new node self-builds its path enum, it is added to SLASH_ONLY_NODE_TYPES (docs/comfy.md - the MPI-246 trap that broke auto-mask on a released build)
